material.acceptance_criteria: a CI job posts a client error and finds one structured log line carrying session, tick and message; gate reports 0 failed on each OS.
material.description: A client posts errors to a server endpoint; the server writes each as a structured log line with session, tick and source. Lives in rust/crates/server http.rs and a new relay module.
material.resolution: POST /client-error route, relay.rs writes one structured log line per error (session capped 64, message capped 256, tick from room). CI job client-error-relay restored at fb155d7 after a later commit had dropped it; byte-identical to its fa59c22a block. Per-client rate limit is a separate row (client-error-relay-rate-limit).
material.subject: Relay client-reported errors into the server log
